review_gate: root executes checks after this READY state; no script runs before authorization
narrative_correction_vs_v1: diag02's WIDTH=16 local was unused; grok.init_params uses frozen WIDTH=64, so the prior FD check probed actual width-64 init params on a 64-pair subset. It never tested saved memorization/final weights, the full 2823-pair batch, or float32-vs-float64 on identical values.

snapshots.log_row_tie_in: init <-> train-log step 0; memorization <-> row at completion-receipt memorization_step; final <-> last row (steps_run)
snapshots.data: grok.build_dataset(); grok.fixed_split(0.30); full enumeration, no subsets

hypotheses.name: float32 forward/backward loses small task gradients after memorization on saved values, seed-0-discriminatingly
hypotheses.observable_prediction: At seed0 memorization and/or final snapshots, float32 autodiff of the full-batch train loss differs materially from float64 autodiff on the identical loaded parameter values and identical batch, on whole-vector or non-degenerate block vectors, while seed0 init and every seeds 1-4 snapshot stay clean.
hypotheses.falsifying_observation: No material defect at seed0 memorization/final (rejected at these snapshots), or defects equally present in other seeds/init (not seed-0-specific).

metric_definitions.relL2: ||g32-g64||_2 / max(||g64||_2, raw_floor); reported for every leaf, block, whole
metric_definitions.cosine: <g32,g64> / (||g32||_2 * max(||g64||_2, raw_floor)); null when either norm < raw_floor; never coerced
metric_definitions.decision_basis: only whole and block vectors with norm64 >= 1e-12; degenerate vectors reported, excluded from material classification
metric_definitions.meaningful_zero: g32[i]==0 AND |g64[i]| > max(1e-12, 1e-6*||g64_whole||_2); g32-zero vs tiny g64 is NEVER classified material (gauge/roundoff safe)
metric_definitions.gauge_sensitive_leaves: raw near-zero leaf errors (e.g. key bias bk) reported separately, never inferred as underflow
metric_definitions.granularity: per leaf, per block (embedding={emb,pos}, attention={wq,bq,wk,bk,wv,bv,wo,bo}, mlp={mlp1,mlp2}, head={head}), whole flattened gradient
metric_definitions.dtype_and_flag_logging: x64 flag and dtypes recorded for both passes; same in-memory arrays reused, float32 dtype asserted before cast; init_params never called

decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.material_defect: on whole or any non-degenerate block (norm64 >= 1e-12): relL2 > 1e-3 OR cosine < 0.999 (when defined) OR meaningful_zero_count > 0 OR nonfinite32 > 0

verdicts.supported_seed0_specific_engineering: material defect at seed0 mem and/or final AND none at seed0 init AND none at any seeds 1-4 snapshot
verdicts.defect_present_not_seed0_specific: material defects also in seeds 1-4 and/or seed0 init; no seed0-specific support; NOT an elimination of float32 training-dynamics effects
verdicts.no_material_defect_at_snapshots: no material defect measured; H1 rejected at these snapshots; NOT an elimination of float32 training-dynamics effects

decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.threshold_justification: float32 unit roundoff 1.19e-7; benign accumulation over 62.5k coords expected whole-vector relL2 <= 1e-5; threshold is 100x above
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.no_causal_claims: even the supported branch is a snapshot-level association, not a demonstrated cause (dynamics not measured)

hypotheses.baseline_tie_in: float32 recomputed train loss vs the EXACT corresponding log row per snapshot (step 0 / memorization_step / steps_run), relative tolerance 1e-5; mismatch aborts as harness defect (retained)
hypotheses.order_of_passes: ALL float32 passes first (x64 off), then single x64 toggle with dtype assertions, then ALL float64 passes; no per-snapshot toggling
hypotheses.negative_anchor: init snapshots (large gradients) must show negligible relL2

positive_control_metric_detector_validat.what: deterministic validation of the metric implementation on one snapshot's g64 (validates detector, NOT the float32 backend; no claim of backend proof)
checks: self-comparison: relL2 exactly 0, cosine >= 1 - 1e-12 (sqrt-vs-dot float64 roundoff slack)
injected 10% scaling g64*1.1: relL2 == 0.1 up to float64 roundoff AND flagged material (> 1e-3)
injected meaningful zero: zero the single largest-|g64| coordinate of a non-degenerate block; meaningful-zero count increments and block flags
positive_control_metric_detector_validat.conclusion_qualification: matched float64 computation may differ by backend paths; conclusions qualified accordingly

hypotheses.precision_context: x64 disabled at import; float32 pass first; then jax.config.update('jax_enable_x64', True) verified by dtype assertions; weights only loaded and explicitly cast; if toggle fails, abort with retained failure record (no silent fallback)
hypotheses.allowed_conclusion: whether float32 autodiff materially distorts loss/gradient on the saved weights and whether it is seed-0-specific
hypotheses.not_supported_conclusion: that float32 precision caused seed0's non-grokking within 10000 steps; anything about steps > 10000; any model change; elimination of precision effects during training in general

hypotheses.name: attention saturation and/or order sensitivity on symmetric unseen pairs (narrowed)
hypotheses.observable_prediction: Seed0's answer-row attention at final (directionally at memorization) shows either (H2a) head_mean_entropy strictly below every grokked seed with head_mean_sat_frac > 0.5 while every grokked seed < 0.1, or (H2c) paired prediction symmetry disagreement > 0.5 on the fixed symmetric unseen set S while every grokked seed < 0.05.
hypotheses.falsifying_observation: All seed0 metrics (entropies, sat fractions, disagreement, input-dependence) within the [min,max] envelope of seeds 1-4 at the same checkpoints.
hypotheses.inconclusive_outcome: No signature fires but at least one seed0 metric lies outside the seeds-1-4 envelope: reported INCONCLUSIVE (honest non-binary), never forced to falsified.

metric_definitions.attention_extraction: diagnostic forward (frozen ops, float32, no x64) returning logits AND per-sample attention maps for all B inputs, because frozen grok.attention_weights returns only the first batch sample ([0][None])
metric_definitions.baseline_match_gate: before any metric/intervention is trusted: custom logits vs frozen grok.forward logits on the fixed test split satisfy |diff| <= 1e-5 + 1e-6*|ref| elementwise (explicit f32-appropriate), AND recomputed test accuracy matches the exact corresponding log row to relative 1e-6; failure aborts as harness defect (retained)
metric_definitions.scope: per snapshot, per head (4), answer row (row 2; positions 0,1,2 causal-visible), all 9409 pairs
metric_definitions.entropy: H = -sum_{j: w_j>0} w_j ln w_j (nats), 0*log0-safe; per-head mean/p10/p50/p90 over pairs
metric_definitions.sat_frac: per head, fraction of pairs with max_j w_j > 0.99; maxw_mean likewise
metric_definitions.aggregates_exactly_defined: head_mean_entropy = mean over 4 heads of per-head pair-means; head_mean_sat_frac = mean over 4 heads of per-head sat_frac
metric_definitions.descriptive_only: input_dep_std (max over positions of std of w over pairs), row-1 entropy mean (row 0 is mask-forced [1,0,0]), masked pre-softmax score min/max/range (finite entries)
metric_definitions.order_sensitivity_set_S: S = {(a,b): a != b, test_mask[a,b] AND test_mask[b,a]} (both orientations unseen), deterministic from frozen split; |S| and sha256 of sorted flat indices reported
metric_definitions.symmetry_disagreement: fraction of (a,b) in S with argmax logits(a,b,'=') != argmax logits(b,a,'=') (targets identical under swap); plus mean absolute logit difference over S
metric_definitions.interventions: I1 pos->0 transient copy, DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (no delta-acc criterion; affects all models' input geometry); harness-liveness: I1 must change logits on >= 1 pair for every snapshot else harness defect
metric_definitions.removed_vs_v1: whole-set swap removed (aggregate-accuracy invariant and leak-prone); I3 a->0 removed (changes true target: destructive input ablation, not task accuracy); score-softening beta=0.5 omitted for minimality (deliberate absence)

decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2a_saturation: seed0 head_mean_entropy at final strictly below every grokked seed AND seed0 head_mean_sat_frac > 0.5 while every grokked seed < 0.1
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.h2c_order_sensitivity: seed0 symmetry disagreement on S > 0.5 while every grokked seed < 0.05 (predeclared positive-association criterion, NOT causal)
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.supported_engineering_level: H2a or H2c at final AND the same metric moves in the same direction at memorization
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.falsified_within_envelope: all seed0 metrics within seeds-1-4 [min,max] span
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.inconclusive_outside_envelope: no signature but >=1 metric outside envelope
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.no_post_hoc_thresholds: all thresholds fixed in this plan before execution
decision_rule_engineering_not_course_gat.control_role: wd0-s0 final descriptor only, never pass/fail

hypotheses.causality_caveat: static-snapshot attention metrics and order-disagreement are conditional associations; they cannot establish a necessary cause of past learning failure; entropy alone never proves cause; position sensitivity alone is not proof of a shortcut
hypotheses.allowed_conclusion: whether seed0's saved attention differs mechanistically (saturation / order sensitivity) from all grokked seeds at the same stages, or is inconclusive
hypotheses.not_supported_conclusion: causal claims about why seed0 did not grok; claims about steps > 10000; eventual-grok or init-cause claims

execution_protocol.single_shot: each script asserts its own result file new (exclusive subdir, O_EXCL semantics) and refuses to overwrite anything including prior plan/READY files
execution_protocol.harness_failures: retained as attempt01; fixes only in new attempt files after re-review; metrics never changed after outcomes
execution_protocol.stdout: one concise PASS/FAIL line per script; full values in JSON
